[SWS_DM_01584] Resetting time-based debouncing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068, RS_Diag_04225
⌈
If a monitor is configured with
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased
and ReportMoni-
torAction is called with
kResetDebouncing
, the DM shall stop the timer and reset
FDC to zero.
⌋
